answer: A voyage-bond resists sybils like this: every new identity must leave a marble at the wharf — a small stake locked in escrow — before it can earn anything, and the stake only unlocks after the identity completes a full season of verified work with no fraud finding. A farm must therefore pay a marble per fake, and each fake that cheats forfeits its stake, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand stakes plus the labor of faking a season of work each.
